lessons_used: Interactive new flows (new_flow) delivered the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several variants caused severe drops (down to -11.8%) or guardrail rollbacks.
Step reordering (reorder) drove major wins (up to +12.0%), though it carried high risk, frequently producing no clear effect or severe drops (down to -8.9%).
UI redesigns (redesign) frequently caused severe drops (down to -19.3%), but a companion selection redesign yielded a major win (+8.5%), vastly outperforming pessimistic predictions (-5.0%).
Wait-state information (wait_info) produced multiple solid wins (up to +6.1%), occasionally exceeding conservative predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2%), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), particularly around account protection and retrieval, though the majority resulted in no clear effect.

Hints (hint), notifications (notification), layout changes (layout), and standalone preview screens (new_screen) failed to produce any wins, with hints sometimes worsening performance (down to -3.1%).

candidates.title: Move Sign-In Before Waiting Generation Stage
candidates.change: Reorders the sign-in step so authentication occurs after adoption certificate creation, right before the long asset waiting stage.
candidates.why: Funnel data shows waiting takes median 201s and sign_in has 8 support tickets regarding account resets; authenticating prior to asset rendering ensures pets are properly attached to account state before long wait times.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of the sign-in step within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Reordering carries high risk with minimal historical gain on sign_in (+0.2%).

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Docking Preview Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive docking preview sub-flow right after waiting stage where users test dragging and anchoring the companion to screen corners.
candidates.why: Support mail highlights 3 issues with controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet on desktop after onboarding; hands-on practice prevents post-setup confusion.

candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 73.5% with high mean duration (5815s); structured layout clarifies next steps and speeds up final release to desktop.

candidates.why: The choose_path step sees the highest initial drop (21.7% drop, 78.3% conversion); adding high-intent activity selection deepens user engagement early in setup.

candidates.why: 16.5% of users abandon during adoption steps; providing a tangible onboarding reward incentivizes users to complete setup.
